_comment: Tobias Sandcrest, Harbour Master of Sandcrest Landing (Scripts/harbour_master.gd, Scenes/harbour_master.tscn). greeting / ambient / secret / quest_hooks / topics are the user's text. ferry_away, merchant_* are DRAFTS awaiting approval. ferry_running lines are for when the Bastion ship is in service (not yet). Ambient lines are said to nearby players every ambient_minutes; at night there is a chance for a secret line. 'topics' = the keyword conversation (Scripts/npc_conversation.gd); {word} in a line is a clickable keyword. The topic lines are DRAFTS awaiting approval.
greeting: Welcome to Sandcrest Landing. Headed north to {Thallia's Bastion}?
Evening, traveler. The {northern route} is clear today.
Sandcrest Landing at your service. Need {passage} to Thallia's Bastion?
ferry_away: I'll sell you a {token}, aye, but I'll be honest: the Bastion ship is a long way out. It'll be a good while before she's back.
The {token}'s good for the crossing, whenever the boat returns. That won't be soon, mind.
Cargo's late and the ship with it. Buy a {token} now if you like, but don't hold your breath for the horn.
ambient: Strong winds today. Might be a rough ride to the Bastion.
If you're bound for Thallia's Bastion, keep your gear tied down. The crossing can get lively.
Strange {fog} rolled in last night... only on the northern {waters}.
{Cargo}'s late again. Bastion captains swear the currents are shifting.
secret: The Bastion's northern cliffs... some say they whisper at night.
I once saw a ship drift in from the north with no crew aboard.
If you hear singing on the water during the crossing, don't answer.
topics_now: Only one route from here - straight north to Thallia's Bastion.
Tickets for the Bastion ferry? Aye, I've got them.
The Bastion's a fine place - strong walls, strong people.
ferry_running: You're just in time - the Bastion ferry will be docking shortly.
Northbound ferry arriving! Prepare to board!
Departure's soon. If you miss it, you'll be waiting for the next tide.
Board when the horn sounds. Stay seated until we clear the shoals.
quest_hooks: A crate bound for Thallia's Bastion went missing last night. If you find it, I'll pay well.
A Bastion captain claims he saw lights beneath the waves. I'd like to know if it's true.
We've had trouble with dock rats again. Nasty ones. Could use a hand.
A message needs delivering to the Bastion's gatekeeper. If you're headed north, take it for me.
merchant_coming: Someone's coming down the road with a pack the size of a house. Sahren, I'd wager. He always stops here first.
Keep an eye on the road, friend. Sahren of the Deep Wells has been walking a while now.
merchant_here: That's Sahren over by the pier. Walks the sands for the love of it, and trades when the mood takes him.
Sahren's set up. He won't stay long. Best have a look at what he's carrying.
merchant_gone: You missed Sahren. He's gone up toward Lumora. Try the town gate.
Sahren's packed up and moved on. You might still catch him at the gate.
merchant_none: Sahren? A Djhanid who walks the sands for the love of it. He passes through now and then. I couldn't give you a day.

lines: That's a question for after dark, friend. Ask me again when the lamps are lit.
Tickets for the Bastion ferry? Aye, I've got them. Have a look.

sequence: Only one route from here - straight north to Thallia's Bastion.
The Bastion's a fine place - strong walls, strong people. But the ship that serves it is a long way out, and I can't tell you when she'll be back.

lines: Strange fog rolled in last night... only on the northern waters. I don't like it.
Cargo's late again. Bastion captains swear the currents are shifting.
Work? Nothing I can hand you just now. But there's always something wanting doing on a dock. Keep your blade sharp, and look in again.
